problem.workflow_name: Tayoca Growth OS | Demand Engine & Revenue Command Center
problem.observed_pattern: Two recent identical editorial approval requests were sequential, approximately 3h05m40s apart.
problem.root_cause: The selector recorded approval_requested_at but left approval_state as review_required, so a later eligible run could select the same opportunity again before a decision.

change.behaviour: A fresh request becomes in-flight before the approval wait; review_required and approval_pending rows are eligible again only after the five-day retry window where applicable.

residual_risk: The observed sequential duplicate-request defect is remediated. An exact simultaneous pre-claim race remains theoretically possible with the current sheet-backed claim update; no such concurrent pattern was observed, so a separate atomic claim store is deferred until evidence warrants it.
next_state: Continue W9 observation and W6 commercial monitoring; no user-action blocker exists.
